title: In the cloud, the precompact handoff hook leaves the handoff stale
why: Measured by the retrospective: at 21:04 CST Nov 12 its handoff was about 2 hours behind on CI and merges, after a hook-prompted rewrite. Owner 21:11 CST: the pre-compact hooks "rnt running well in the cloud".
note: Find the cause: whether the PreCompact hook fires in the cloud at all, whether the checkpoint fires before the cloud's 384k trigger (steps handoff-checkpoint-before-cloud-compact and handoff-checkpoint-before-compact are done, so this may be a regression), and whether the post-compaction rewrite draws on a stale digest. Red first on a cloud fixture. Triage sighting 21:16 CST: in this session after the 21:00 compaction, the state line was current but the push times it carried were written from memory (stamp-guard-bracket-form). Handoff-audit-after-compact is the backstop, not the fix. Started by coordinator 21:18 CST Nov 12: one lane for both steps, two PRs, the audit line first. Lane 21:22 CST Nov 12 (via coordinator): owner item 676 late-handoff-checkpoint asks a (second checkpoint 20k below the hook threshold when the first fired more than 75k earlier; recommended) or b (rely on the audit, #3062). Measured: coordinator window 480000, threshold 441600, hook threshold 408000 at override 92, one checkpoint at about 334k. Lane waits on the hook part; finishes #3062 round 1 meanwhile. Item 676 closed 01:09 CST Nov 13 with option a, taken by triage under rule parallelism-keep-going (undoable; matches the owner's 00:50 CST note expecting several nudges). Lane builds the second nudge about 20k under the line when the gap to the first exceeds 75k; red test first; guard-change review rounds.
